description.en: A small upright lycopsid carries fertile axis regions without separate compact cones.
description.zh: 小型直立石松类植物的枝轴育性区不形成独立紧密球果。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Omphalophloios wagneri; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Omphalophloios wagneri 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Elongated fertile axes rather than terminal strobili create a different reproductive silhouette.
distinctness.zh: 延长的育性枝轴而非顶生孢子叶穗形成不同生殖轮廓。

modeling_brief.en: Separate leafy and fertile axis zones with geometry; retain occasional upper division only where referenced.
modeling_brief.zh: 用几何区分有叶区与育性区，仅在有依据处保留上部分叉。

assets.uncertainty: Whole-plant reconstruction is partial; uncertain basal parts remain restrained.

description.en: An unbranched leafy column rises from a rounded rooting base.
description.zh: 不分枝有叶柱轴从圆钝生根基部直立生出。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Chaloneria cormosa; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Chaloneria cormosa 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Rounded basal body and continuous unbranched architecture differ from tall fork-crowned lycopsid trees.
distinctness.zh: 圆钝基体及连续无分枝轴区别于高大叉冠石松树。

modeling_brief.en: Emphasize the basal swelling and upward leaf progression; avoid adding diamond cushions borrowed from Lepidodendron.
modeling_brief.zh: 强调基部膨大及向上叶序，不借用鳞木菱形叶枕。

assets.uncertainty: Original specimen plates are needed for leaf and fertile-zone layout.

description.en: A short erect axis bears terminal quill-like leaves above a ribbed rooting base.
description.zh: 短直立轴在具肋生根基部上方形成顶端针带状叶簇。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Nathorstiana; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Nathorstiana 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Ribbed basal rooting body and cone-free preserved crown distinguish it from Pleuromeia, not merely by scale.
distinctness.zh: 具肋生根基体及保存中无顶穗的叶冠区别于Pleuromeia，并非仅尺寸变化。

modeling_brief.en: Expose the basal radial ribbing and a modest terminal leaf bundle; leave reproductive structures absent.
modeling_brief.zh: 显露基部放射肋及适量顶叶束，不添加未知生殖结构。

assets.uncertainty: Reproductive organs are unknown; whole-plant restoration needs fossil plate review.

sources.supports: Pleuromeia and Nathorstiana broad reconstructed forms and periods.

description.en: A cylindrical calcified algal skeleton has an axial cavity and repeated lateral openings.
description.zh: 圆筒钙化藻骨架具轴腔及重复侧开口。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Diplopora, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Diplopora 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Continuous perforated cylinder differs from Halimeda's articulated plates and Clypeina's projecting discs.
distinctness.zh: 连续穿孔筒区别于Halimeda关节片和Clypeina外突盘。

modeling_brief.en: Model a short hollow fossil tube with a few regular pore rows; section geometry must follow the chosen specimen.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作短中空化石管及少数规则孔列，截面几何遵从选定标本。

assets.uncertainty: Historical genus concept includes differing forms; production requires an updated specimen-level check.
